archive.catalogue_description: Der Berg is the back door of Der Riese. A similar place that is built on a different place on the same world.

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it. Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3).  DEDI 2026-09-22 (runs map03, join67-join72): the ONLY custom map that boots cleanly and answers getstatus in 3 s -- and the server stops simulating 5.6 s in, every time, with a real client attached. Mechanism, named with a data breakpoint in join72: the map's scripts enumerate an object with ~3,900 child variables, and the engine's `scrVmPub.localVars` push loop at 0x697B60 has no bound check, so it overruns 0x28D78 bytes past gScrVmPub (0x3BD4700) into .bss and overwrites the `r_reflectionProbeGenerate` dvar pointer at 0x3BFD478 with a count. The packet receive dereferences that pointer on every WSAEWOULDBLOCK (0x5FFE23), the frame body unwinds and com_frameTime freezes at ~5.6 s. RETRACTION: dedi.md 12.5 called this 'a dvar the dedicated server never registered'; the dvar exists and registering it (join69) changed nothing. Fixing it means bounding that loop or enlarging localVars -- an engine-limit job, not attempted. dedi.md 13.1-13.2.
